title: Spikes wrap score below zero into 65136 instead of clamping at 0
observed: Score was 100 when the player stepped onto spikes at (1,1)-path tick 3; score became 65136 (100 - 500 wrapped as unsigned 16-bit). Later the score showed -300 at tick 13 after a coin.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score never goes below 0, so it should read 0 after the spike hit, and never negative or wrapped.

title: Pause keypress still moves the player in the same tick; restart leaves game paused
observed: Token 'esc+right' paused the game but the player still moved from (1,1) to (2,1) with a 'move' event. After 'click:btn-restart' the mode stayed 'paused' instead of 'playing', with no restart of running state.
expected: Pause takes effect immediately and the rest of that tick's input is ignored, so the player should stay at (1,1). Restart level should put the game back to running straight away with score 0, 3 lives, timer 300.

title: Restart from pause menu leaves mode paused while enemies and state reset
observed: Pause tick 'esc+right' moved the player and advanced enemies (e1 2,5 to 1,5 region, e2 9,4 to 9,3). After 'click:btn-restart' the state reset (enemies back to start) but mode stayed 'paused'.
expected: Restart level puts the level back to start and the game is running again straight away; nothing should move while paused, and the pause tick should not move enemies or the player.

title: HUD shows stale Coins 0/5 after collecting a coin
observed: After 'dash-down' collected a coin (state coins=1, Score 100), the HUD still displayed 'Coins 0/5'.
expected: The HUD always shows current values, so after collecting one coin it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

title: Game stays paused with no dialog after restart; all input ignored
observed: After 'esc' then 'click:btn-restart', the mode remains 'paused' with no pause menu shown, and 30 further wait ticks change nothing; the game is frozen.
expected: Restart level returns the game to running immediately, so the game should respond to input and advance the timer.

title: Toast covers the Resume button in the pause menu
observed: While the 'Key collected' toast is visible, the pause menu's btn-resume reports top=false, meaning another element sits over it and clicks on Resume do not reach it.
expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover it, so Resume must receive clicks while the pause menu is open.

title: Spikes wrap score below zero (100 - 500 shows 65136, later -300)
observed: Spikes at tick 3 with score 100 set score to 65136 (wrapped unsigned value of 100-500). Later a coin left the score at -300.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score stops at 0, never below 0. Score should be 0 after the spike hit, then 100 after the coin at tick 6.

title: Gem pickup wraps score from 65236 to 4700
observed: At tick 37 a gem (+5000) pushed the score from 65236 to 4700, a 16-bit wrap at 65536 (70236 mod 65536). The score dropped without spikes.
expected: Gem adds +5000, so score should be 70236. Score must never drop except through spikes or restart, and is capped at 999,999.

title: HUD coin counter stale after coin pickup (shows 0/5 with 1 coin)
observed: After dash-down collected a coin, state shows coins=1 but HUD reads 'Coins 0/5', and it stays stale on the next tick.
expected: HUD always shows current values, so after collecting one coin it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

title: Score goes negative (-400, then -800) after spikes and coins
observed: Score is -400 at tick 43 after a coin, and -800 at tick 66. The score was already wrapped (65036) from earlier spikes, so the coin produced -400 instead of 65136.
expected: Score is never negative and spikes stop at 0. The score should stay at a non-negative value after each coin or spike.

title: HUD coin counter lags state (Coins 0/5 while coins=1)
observed: At tick 1, dash-right collected a coin: state coins=1 but HUD shows 'Coins 0/5'. Later at tick 5 state coins=2 while HUD shows 'Coins 1/5'.
expected: HUD shows the current coin count at all times, so it should read 'Coins 1/5' at tick 1.
